content.text: Manual order fulfillment is a trap that most creators do not recognize until it breaks at exactly the wrong moment. It functions at five sales per month. It breaks when you are asleep and a buyer in a different timezone completes a purchase and waits eight hours for a download link that should have arrived in 30 seconds. It breaks when a webhook notification gets buried in your inbox. It breaks under volume in ways that destroy buyer trust that took months to build. The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-one-afternoon|Automated Ebook]] pipeline that COREMERCH deploys eliminates every manual step permanently. When a buyer pays in crypto, NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-what-nobody-tells|payment]]s detects the on-chain transaction and fires a webhook to your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how-3|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order to Supabase or Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email via Resend or Gmail — all within 30 seconds of payment confirmation.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

The webhook is the technical mechanism that makes automated digital delivery possible at scale. When a buyer completes a crypto payment, NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction. When the transaction receives the configured number of confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL you configured in your NOWPayments dashboard. This is the URL of your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App. The endpoint receives the webhook payload, validates the signature against the secret key you configured, and begins order processing immediately.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The order processing sequence that follows webhook receipt is fully automated and completes in under 30 seconds in almost all cases. The backend reads the payment amount and compares it to the expected amount for the product ordered. It retrieves the transaction hash from the webhook payload and confirms the transaction independently on the relevant blockchain. If the transaction is confirmed on-chain and the amount matches, the backend logs the order to Supabase or Google Sheets with all relevant metadata, generates a receipt, creates a time-limited download link for the product file, and sends the delivery email via Resend or Gmail.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Manual fulfillment has specific failure modes that automated systems eliminate permanently. Time zone gaps cause hours-long delivery delays when buyers in Asia or Europe purchase while the seller is asleep in Africa. Notification fatigue causes orders to go unnoticed when webhook emails are buried in an inbox. Human error causes the wrong file to be sent or the wrong buyer to receive a link. Volume spikes overwhelm a manual process that functions at low order rates but breaks under simultaneous demand. The automated pipeline handles all of these cases identically — ten simultaneous orders from buyers in different time zones are processed as ten independent webhook events, each receiving the same automated treatment within 30 seconds.
Every order gets the same automated treatment — whether it arrives at noon or 3am, one order or ten simultaneously.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers is the backend engine in Stack 02 deployments. It runs serverless JavaScript at the edge — code that executes in response to HTTP requests, including the incoming NOWPayments webhook. The free tier provides 100,000 requests per day, which is sufficient for the sales volume of most individual digital product sellers. Workers has no server to manage, no runtime to configure, and no infrastructure to maintain. It scales automatically and is globally distributed — the same code runs in data centers close to wherever the request originates.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Monitoring an automated pipeline requires significantly less time than managing a manual process. The order database — whether Google Sheets or Supabase — provides a complete real-time log of every transaction. Each entry shows payment confirmation status, delivery status, and the timestamp of each step. Exceptions — transactions that confirmed on-chain but triggered a delivery failure — appear as flagged entries. Checking the order log once per day identifies any exceptions that require manual attention. In practice, a well-configured sovereign stack generates fewer than one exception per hundred orders.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment data, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, and sends the delivery email with a time-limited download link.
Webhook fires, backend verifies on-chain, order logs, receipt generates, delivery email sends — all within 30 seconds.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching automated webhook delivery and crypto payment fulfillment pipelines are often moving from manual order processing to a system that operates without constant attention. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 includes the complete automated pipeline: NOWPayments webhook handling in Cloudflare Workers, order logging to Supabase, and delivery email via Resend — all configured, tested, and running under your accounts before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete technical implementation for both Stack 01 and Stack 02. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
